messages:
Priya: Dropping a quick review of the compact Rollouts timeline. Goal: make it denser for long histories, keep rollback discoverable, avoid color-only status. Figma: https://figma.com/file/ijkl (frame: compact-timeline-v1)

Diego: Love the density. Proposal: collapse groups older than 14 days into a stacked summary row. Show counts + an expand affordance.

Rae (a11y): A11y points: 1) status chips need icons + text, not color alone; 2) ensure contrast ratio >=4.5 for chip text; 3) keyboard nav: arrow keys to move between rows and Enter to expand. Use `role=button` and visible focus ring.

Priya: Noted. We'll add an outlined flame icon + "Canary — 15m" label and increase contrast. Also will add keyboard affordances.

Sam: Copy suggestions: change "Abort" to "Pause & inspect" in the inline menu to reduce panic. For rollback CTA use "Initiate rollback" and show a 30s undo snackbar.

Diego: Implementation note: server can return a lightweight metadata blob on list endpoints to avoid extra calls when expanding many rows. Use `compact=true` flag.

Rae (a11y): When auto-expanding a failed row, move focus into the expanded content and announce with a polite live region. For critical failures use `role=alert`.

ops-bot: Screenshot uploaded: https://assets.company.com/compact-timeline-v1.png

Priya: Thanks all  I'll update the mock with icons, improved contrast, copy tweaks, and keyboard flows, then post the next frame tomorrow morning.
